purpose: Retired positional source ARRAY contributes copied raw values, while real Generator copy retains capture, receiver and yield cache through close.
source:
<?php
class Token108A { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Capture108A { function __destruct() { echo 'CAPTURE|'; } }
class Receiver108A { public $tag = 31; function __destruct() { echo 'RECEIVER|'; } }
function Pack108A() {
    global $source, $receiver, $pack;
    $saved = $pack; $source = null; $receiver = null; $pack = null;
    echo 'PACK|'; return $saved;
}
$capture = new Capture108A();
$source = function ($first, $second) use ($capture) {
    global $weakToken, $weakCapture;
    echo 'BODY|', $this->tag, '|', $first === $weakToken->get(), '|', $capture === $weakCapture->get(), '|';
    try { yield $first; } finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    return $second;
};
$weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); unset($capture);
$receiver = new Receiver108A(); $weakReceiver = WeakReference::create($receiver);
$token = new Token108A(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$pack = [4 => $token, 9 => 47]; unset($token);
echo 'CALL|'; $generator = $source->call($receiver, ...Pack108A());
echo 'CREATED|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakReceiver->get() instanceof Receiver108A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token108A, '|';
echo 'CURRENT|', $generator->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|';
$generator->next(); echo 'RETURN|', $generator->getReturn(), '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token108A, '|';
unset($generator); echo 'GONE|', $weakReceiver->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|';

purpose: Distinct ARRAY packs reset positional-after-named ordering; named newThis is separate and canonical positional forwarding precedes inner named arguments.
source:
<?php
class Maker108B {
    public $tag;
    function __construct($tag) { $this->tag = $tag; }
    function stream($first = 11, $second = 19) { echo 'BODY|', $this->tag, '|', $first, '|', $second, '|'; yield $first; return $second; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|', $this->tag, '|'; }
}
$old = new Maker108B(7); $source = $old->stream(...); unset($old);
$receiver = new Maker108B(31);
$generator = $source->call(...['second' => 23], ...['newThis' => $receiver], ...[17]);
echo 'CREATED|', $generator instanceof Generator, '|';
unset($source, $receiver); echo 'CURRENT|', $generator->current(), '|';
$generator->next(); echo 'RETURN|', $generator->getReturn(), '|'; unset($generator); echo 'DONE|';
